scripts.dev: npm run build -w @kitchen/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @kitchen/shared" "npm run dev -w @kitchen/server" "npm run dev -w @kitchen/client"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @kitchen/shared && npm run dev -w @kitchen/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @kitchen/shared && npm run dev -w @kitchen/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kitchen/shared && npm run build -w @kitchen/server && npm run build -w @kitchen/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @kitchen/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
